summary: First-run full-stack testing of BazaarMind. Backend: 15/15 pytest passed against all P0 endpoints including LIVE Gemini (interpret, shopping-list parse, ask, image interpret). Frontend: Landing, Pulse, Shop, Vendor (with confirm dialog & publish), Ask (live Gemini), and all navigation routes (/network, /business, /more) load and integrate correctly. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: On Gemini failure the API returns HTTP 200 with ok=false instead of a 5xx. Intentional UX choice but inconsistent with REST — clients cannot distinguish transport vs semantic failure via status code. Same for /api/ask-bazaar and /api/shopping-list/parse.

ui_bugs.issue: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. The dynamic wrapper span is being injected inside a <select><option>. Causes console error on /more.

issues: After the AI comparison list renders, product rows appear low-contrast/greyed out (see screenshot) even for items with status tight — the 'tight' pill blends with muted text. Verify intended emphasis for tight vs ok rows.

action_items: Fix More.jsx market selector: remove the dynamic wrapper <span> inside <option>. Render {m.name} directly, or use a non-native Select (shadcn) so the DOM stays valid.
Consider returning proper 5xx status when Gemini interpret/ask/parse throw so frontend can differentiate — currently frontend must key off ok flag only.
(Optional) Review contrast/emphasis on shopper list comparison rows so tight items visually stand out.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py catches exceptions on interpret/ask/parse and returns 200 with ok=false. This masks real failures in monitoring. Suggest returning 502/503 while keeping ok=false payload.
demo_seed.seed_if_empty only seeds when collections empty — good for idempotency, but there is no way to reset synthetic data without dropping DB (fine for demo).
gemini_service._extract_json uses greedy regex to find first JSON object. Safe today but could break if Gemini returns multiple code blocks; consider using json.JSONDecoder.raw_decode with fallback.
intelligence.compute_market_pulse loads all confirmed signals per request (to_list 5000). At real pilot scale, add Mongo aggregation pipeline / product index.
Prices are cast via int() in reportedPriceSignal string, which will truncate 55.5 -> 55. Round would be more honest.
CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; browsers ignore credentials. Since no auth, harmless.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds synthetic demo-ina market on startup. Tests created a few TEST_ prefixed vendor signals against Tomatoes (confirmed) and 2 moderation-pending signals. Slight inflation of vendorObservations for Tomatoes; safe to ignore or reseed by dropping db.market_signals.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 15 backend pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py pass. Live Gemini calls take ~4-8s each; total suite runs in ~45s. Frontend testids of note: shopper-chat-input, shopper-send-button, vendor-text-input (NOT vendor-signal-input), vendor-send-signal-button, vendor-confirm-publish-button, ask-gemini-input, ask-send-button. Default market id 'demo-ina'. Skip re-testing unless main agent changes backend intelligence or Gemini schemas.
